contract.text: Every canonical live-forward artifact date reaches a terminal resolution status (resolved or verified, voids allowed) within the resolution grace window (code default 3 days, CRITICAL at 7); because the resumed portion of a suspended game is never evaluated for BTS, rows on such a game must end terminal (void), not pending.
contract.source: src/bts/health/live_forward_resolution.py DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS + SUCCESS_STATUSES (at 3081948); design §6.2 V8 ('stranded (pending past its pinned age threshold)'); official rules §6 'Regarding Suspended Games' (docs/audit/2026-09-29-incident-register-evidence/rules/section6.txt)

mechanism.text: MLB keeps a suspended-then-resumed game's original officialDate, so game 824912's PA stayed filed under 2026-06-16 while the live-forward slate dated its rows on the resume day 2026-06-17; the resolver's (date, game_pk) outcome join never matched and no terminal-void route covered the case, so the rows stayed pending and the date never resolved

the daily slate offered resume-date games: _fetch_game_slots kept schedule games whose officialDate is earlier than the queried date, so a never-evaluable game entered the ranked slates (and could be picked)

verified_recovered.how: the live-forward resolve timer regenerated 2026-06-17 with 'Candidate artifact verification: PASS (0 failures)' (reported by the 7/01 production-state audit)

residual.text: By design the resolver still leaves pending a row whose game has slate-date PA but none for the batter, or whose game is absent from PA entirely; such a date can still strand and then relies on the live_forward_resolution alert.

watchdog.trigger: daily after the live-forward resolve timer, checked outside the scheduler's in-process health runner: a canonical artifact date older than the 3-day grace window whose resolution status is not a success status (existing_verified[_with_voids], resolved_verified, resolved_with_voids)
watchdog.recovery_assertion: the date's resolution status reaches a success status within one resolve cycle after the fix is live, and the stall alert clears
